selection: Per model family, maximize F1 on new random development validation; ties: precision, then simpler model (smaller C or fewer epochs/lower learning rate), then higher threshold
abort_condition: Validation lacks both resolved binary classes; collect more development labels rather than use test labels
refit: After settings are frozen, refit on all resolved development labels; no test-based revisions
final_evaluation: Verify packet hashes, load fresh test only after fitting, evaluate once; report unresolved/excluded passages and confusion counts
